description: Versioned, auditable inputs to the Knowledge Evolution Engine. Weights live here rather than in code so that a change to how currency is computed is visible in review and attributable to a commit. The engine records which version produced every score.

decay.description: Half-life in days per evidence class. Confidence in a claim decays toward `floor` on this half-life without human action. Field data ages differently from an analytical derivation because the world it described moves.

criticalityImpact.description: Points deducted from currency when an unresolved impact of this criticality exists.

criticalityTransition.description: Currency status a knowledge object transitions to when impacted at this criticality. MINOR impacts are recorded and surfaced but do not gate the knowledge, because gating on noise trains reviewers to dismiss everything.

criticalityCreatesTask.description: Whether an impact at this criticality opens a human revalidation task.

changeTypeCriticalityFloor.description: Some change types are severe enough that they raise a dependency's declared criticality. A retracted piece of evidence invalidates a conclusion regardless of how the dependency was declared. Values are the minimum criticality applied; the more severe of (declared, floor) wins.

statusFloor.description: Currency score is clamped to at most this value while in the given status, so a recently-verified item cannot display as healthy while it carries an unresolved blocking impact.

grading.description: Currency bands for display. These are presentation thresholds only; no decision logic keys off them.
